summary: Operator site (2013/2014, under construction), Google, RV Life, Dyrt and imagery read. It is a public private campground (not a retreat centre), but mostly seasonal/resident, the only posted rate is from 2014, and Google shows 2 reviews with no phone: DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay character with no dated nightly rate; mostly seasonal and iffy). No groups written. Pin ~330 m off (on the highway).
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay test 2 + mostly seasonal and iffy): camper reports 'much of cg has apparent permanent campers' (Dyrt 2022-08-29), 'Many resident sites' (Dyrt 2023-07-28); RV Life 'some seasonals around'; imagery shows trailers with sheds/decks along the river road and a row of private docks. The operator's own rate page is titled '2014 Rates' ('RV Camping W-E-D $25.00'; 'Extended stays & Groups are negotiable') and the site footer is dated 2013 with 'UNDER CONSTRUCTION'; no 2024+ rate from the operator exists, so a long-stay-in-character park fails test 2 (RV Life $$ tier does not stand in).

LONG-STAY TESTS: (1) nightly share: not measurable from the operator; reports and imagery put most sites as seasonal/resident (estimate under ~30% nightly); (2) posted nightly rate: only a 2014 sheet -> FAIL; (3) booking: phone only, no engine; (4) wording: 'Extended stays & Groups are negotiable' (neutral, not discouraging); (5) presence: website resolves with a phone but is stale since 2013; Google Maps 5.0 from 2 reviews, no phone on the listing.
RETREAT CENTRE QUESTION: no. The operator sells RV and primitive campsites to the public by phone; lodges and a banquet hall are side rentals. It is not a camp/retreat facility.
PIN: stored 41.6482,-90.3357 is on Route 84 east of the railroad, at the entrance road; the camping area centre is about 41.6458,-90.3375 (~330 m SSW).

WATERFRONT: stored 'not waterfront' left. Trailers along the river road sit ~40-50 m from the Mississippi behind the road and a tree line, but they appear to be seasonal setups with private docks; no site is shown to be sold nightly.
PHONE/WEBSITE: 309-523-2168 and camphauberg.org unchanged (both still on the operator site; Google lists no phone).
PRICE GATE: $25 (2014) would pass, but it is undated for gate purposes. Good Sam: not a GS Park. Gateway not relevant.
